concept: Two variables share one name: shadowed state variables in inherited Solidity contracts lead to ambiguity about which one is read.
scene: Two stacked contract blocks labeled A and B on a deep navy background, each holding a box named x. Thin amber lines connect each box to a separate code reader, showing one name resolving to two separate variables. Minimal, calm, technical layout with generous space for overlay text.
alt_text: Diagram of two contract blocks, A and B, each containing its own variable named x, with separate amber lines showing that each contract reads a different copy.
